id: title:jurajmajerik:block removing variants from a flag backing a running experiment

review.posthog_relevance: Protects Feature Flag and Experiment consistency by preventing configuration changes that could invalidate an active experiment, while allowing safe updates.
review.reason: The observed hunk P1.F1.H1 implements a serializer check that prevents removing or renaming variant keys on a Feature Flag while an experiment is active. This preserves the integrity of the experiment's results by avoiding configuration changes that would make the stored experiment data incompatible with the current flag state.
